shortDescription: The Virginia-Based Company Deepens Its Investment in the Commonwealth’s Biggest RivalrySMITHFIELD, Va., Sept. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Smithfield today announced it will continue as the presenting sponsor of the Commonwealth Clash, the annual rivalry between the University of Virginia and Virgi…

children: The Virginia-Based Company Deepens Its Investment in the Commonwealth’s Biggest Rivalry

today announced it will continue as the presenting sponsor of the Commonwealth Clash, the annual rivalry between the University of Virginia and Virginia Tech, for the 2026–27 season. Building on more than a decade of partnership with both universities, Smithfield will continue celebrating school spirit while supporting local communities and introducing new fan engagement opportunities throughout the upcoming season.

“As a company born and built in Virginia, there are few partnerships more meaningful to us than the Commonwealth Clash," said Brendan Smith, senior vice president of marketing for Smithfield Foods. “Great rivalries deserve great traditions, and the Commonwealth Clash delivers both. Whether you’re cheering for the Cavaliers or the Hokies, we are excited to make this season even more memorable with new ways for fans to celebrate their teams, fuel the rivalry and show off their Virginia pride."

Since the 2014–15 academic year, Smithfield has partnered with the University of Virginia and Virginia Tech across all school-sponsored sports, helping to amplify one of Virginia's most spirited rivalries.

New for the 2026–27 school year, Smithfield will introduce the Smithfield “Baconbassador” Program, a fan engagement initiative designed to bring bacon-obsessed students, notable alumni and athletes closer to the Commonwealth Clash experience. From tailgates and campus traditions to social storytelling and rivalry-week celebrations, Baconbassadors will help bring the sizzle to the Clash, serving as enthusiastic champions of their respective schools while bringing the authentic fan experience to the conversation.

"The Commonwealth Clash represents the very best of Virginia athletics, bringing together our student-athletes, alumni and fans through friendly competition, tradition and school pride,” said Sam Schauf, general manager of Virginia Tech Sports Properties. “Smithfield has been a valued partner in helping elevate this rivalry for more than a decade, and we're excited to see new initiatives like the Baconbassador Program and community food drive create even more opportunities for Cavaliers fans to engage with the Clash while supporting our local community."

"The Commonwealth Clash is one of the most anticipated traditions of the year for Hokie Nation, and we're proud to continue building on our longstanding partnership with Smithfield,” said David Perry, general manager of Virginia Sports Properties. “From celebrating our student-athletes to creating memorable fan experiences and giving back through community initiatives, these new programs will bring even more excitement to the rivalry while making a meaningful impact across the Commonwealth."

While the Commonwealth Clash fuels spirited competition on the field, Smithfield remains committed to strengthening the communities that support both universities. Throughout the season, Smithfield will rally Cavalier and Hokie fans around a shared cause through a food drive benefiting campus food assistance programs. Fans can participate by donating nonperishable food items at designated on-campus collection sites, with donations tracked throughout the season. Smithfield will provide financial support to both campus food assistance programs, and the school with the greatest total weight of donated food will earn Community Champion status.
For more information about the Commonwealth Clash and on-campus activities, recipes and meal inspiration, visit www.smithfield.com or follow @smithfieldbrand on
, TikTok and Facebook, as well as @uva and @hokiesports, for the latest rivalry updates and school spirit moments.
